name: states--needs-long-press
covers: src/ui/player/QuoteShare.tsx::toast::Couldn't make the picture — try again when you're online.
reason: opened only by a long-press (transcript line menu and its Report a mistake sheet, copy, share as picture; the episode title copy; a related card's episode sheet) and the step language has no long-press step

name: show--paid-episodes-and-tips
reason: paid episodes, tips and gifts load only through Google Play billing (the block is not drawn without it); the buy, tip and gift toasts and the gift share sheet are store flows

name: states--device-only
reason: needs real hardware or other apps: "Play on mobile data?" appears only on a cellular connection; chat-app share targets need those apps installed; the save-picture share fallback only runs when the photo module is absent; "Download to Watch" needs a paired Apple Watch

name: states--next-up-unused
reason: the NextUp block is no longer drawn by any screen (the episode page uses RelatedEpisodes, the player uses the end offer); its empty state is shot as episode--related-empty
